title: Expectations-based Capital Inflow Shocks
title_primary: Expectations-based Capital Inflow Shocks
authors: Jongrim Ha, Dohan Kim, M. Ayhan Kose, Francis E. Warnock
official: 官方在线 2026-09-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Identifying the impact of capital inflows on output is challenging because inflows are forward-looking and respond to expectations about future economic conditions. We develop a new measure of capital inflow shocks using a simple and broadly applicable expectations-based framework that isolates the unexpected component of inflows by purging movements predicted by professional forecasters’ expectations. Estimates using the new measure for 27 emerging market economies indicate that capital inflows have sizable expansionary effects on output, operating through stronger domestic consumption and investment and easier financing conditions. Additional analysis indicates that equity-type inflows generate greater and more persistent effects than debt-type inflows, while large inflow reversals result in more pronounced effects than comparable increases in inflows. These results are robust to a wide range of alternative specifications.

title: Default and Interest Rate Shocks: Renegotiation Matters
title_zh: 违约与利率冲击：再谈判至关重要
title_primary: 违约与利率冲击：再谈判至关重要
title_secondary: Default and Interest Rate Shocks: Renegotiation Matters
authors: Nicolini, Juan, Almeida, Victor, Esquivel, Carlos, Kehoe, Timothy J.
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We develop a sovereign default model with debt renegotiation in which interest-rate shocks affect default incentives through two mechanisms. Under the standard mechanism, higher interest rates tighten the government’s budget constraint. Under the renegotiation mechanism, higher rates increase lenders’ opportunity cost of holding delinquent debt, which makes lenders accept larger haircuts and makes default more attractive for the government. We argue that our novel renegotiation mechanism reconciles standard sovereign default models with the narrative that the sharp increase in the real interest rate in the United States was a relevant factor in the defaults of the early 1980s.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含债务重议的主权违约模型，其中利率冲击通过两种机制影响违约激励。在标准机制下，较高的利率收紧政府的预算约束。在重议机制下，较高的利率增加了贷款方持有违约债务的机会成本，这促使贷款方接受更大的减记，并使政府违约更具吸引力。我们认为，我们提出的新颖重议机制调和了标准主权违约模型与关于20世纪80年代初美国实际利率急剧上升是违约重要因素的叙述。

title: Productivity and Entry Regulation in the Service Sector: Evidence from the Universe of Firms in Italy
title_zh: 服务业生产率与准入规制：来自意大利全量企业的证据
title_primary: 服务业生产率与准入规制：来自意大利全量企业的证据
title_secondary: Productivity and Entry Regulation in the Service Sector: Evidence from the Universe of Firms in Italy
authors: A Cintolesi, S Mocetti, G Roma
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Burdensome entry regulations can hinder productivity growth, particularly in services where competitive pressures are weaker. We construct a novel measure of entry regulation, varying across narrowly defined sectors, and combine it with firm-level data for the universe of Italian firms. Exploiting reforms that generate variation across sectors and over time, we find that deregulation (reductions in red tape) raises productivity. The effect is driven by incumbent firms, with a smaller role for reallocation and selection. Effects are larger in the lower-middle of the productivity distribution and in sectors with higher entry rates and tighter initial regulation.
abstract_zh: 繁重的准入规制可能阻碍生产率增长，尤其是在竞争压力较弱的服务业中。我们构建了一种新的准入规制衡量指标，该指标在细分行业间存在差异，并将其与意大利全部企业的企业层面数据相结合。利用跨行业及随时间变化的改革所带来的差异，我们发现放松规制（减少行政手续）能提升生产率。这一效应主要由在位企业驱动，而重新配置与选择机制的作用较小。在生产率分布的中低端以及进入率较高、初始规制较严格的行业中，效应更为显著。

title: Social identification and equilibrium law enforcement
title_zh: 社会认同与均衡执法
title_primary: 社会认同与均衡执法
title_secondary: Social identification and equilibrium law enforcement
authors: Claude Fluet, Tim Friehe
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper studies how social identification reshapes the political economy of law enforcement. In a two-class economy with property crime, individuals choose whether to offend, vote over the detection probability under majority rule, and choose whether to identify with their class or with the encompassing nation. In the absence of identity concerns, class-specific material preferences over enforcement depend on victimization exposure, tax incidence, and the option value of offending. With class identification, voters place greater weight on the relative payoff of their own group, so social identity amplifies the underlying distributive conflict. With national identification, voters place greater weight on aggregate payoffs, compressing preferred enforcement levels across groups. Endogenous identity choice produces distinct political regimes and can generate multiple equilibria: societies in which class differences are more salient in identity space are more likely to sustain class identification and more extreme enforcement outcomes, whereas higher national prestige favors national identification and policies closer to the aggregate benchmark. An extension in which offending carries an action-based social deviance cost preserves the main mechanism and shows how compliance norms can reinforce class-based identity.
abstract_zh: 本文研究社会认同如何重塑执法领域的政治经济学。在一个存在财产犯罪的两阶级经济体中，个体需选择是否犯罪、通过多数决规则投票决定犯罪侦破概率，并选择认同自身阶级或包容性国家。在缺乏身份认同的情况下，阶级间对执法的物质偏好差异取决于受害风险、税收负担及犯罪的机会成本。当存在阶级认同时，选民更重视本群体的相对收益，因此社会认同会加剧潜在的分配冲突。当存在国家认同时，选民更重视总体收益，从而压缩不同群体间的偏好执法水平。内生身份选择会产生不同的政治体制，并可能形成多重均衡：在身份空间中阶级差异更显著的社会，更易维持阶级认同并导致更极端的执法结果；而国家声望越高，则更有利于国家认同及更接近总体基准的政策。本文扩展模型引入基于行为的犯罪社会越轨成本，在保留核心机制的同时，揭示了合规规范如何强化阶级认同。

title: On verifiable cheap talk and social welfare
title_zh: 关于可验证廉价谈话与社会福利
title_primary: 关于可验证廉价谈话与社会福利
title_secondary: On verifiable cheap talk and social welfare
authors: R. Venkatesh
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We consider a standard model of cheap talk when the receiver has the option to verify the sender’s message at some cost. Verification entails a trade-off for the receiver: learning the state perfectly versus not paying the cost of verifying. An equilibrium partition consists of a mix of verified and unverified intervals, similar in structure to Bijkerk et al. (2018). We analyze a subset of equilibria with exactly one unverified interval. Fixing the informativeness of the equilibrium and the bias between sender and receiver, we show that, for a small bias, joint welfare is non-monotonic in the cost of verification, and for larger biases, it is always increasing in the cost of verification. Further, when costs decrease to the point where informativeness increases, welfare increases discontinuously. Finally, joint welfare is also non-monotonic in the bias between the sender and receiver. Our results suggest that the introduction of a verification technology may have both non-monotonic and discontinuous effects on societal welfare, depending on its cost and the conflict of interest between the agents.
abstract_zh: 我们考虑一个标准的廉价交谈模型，其中接收者可以选择支付一定成本来验证发送者的信息。验证对接收者而言涉及一种权衡：完美了解状态与不支付验证成本之间的选择。均衡分割由已验证和未验证区间的混合构成，其结构与Bijkerk等人（2018）类似。我们分析了一类恰好包含一个未验证区间的均衡子集。在固定均衡的信息量和发送者与接收者之间的偏差时，我们证明，对于较小的偏差，联合福利在验证成本上是非单调的；而对于较大的偏差，联合福利总是随验证成本增加而增加。此外，当成本降低到信息量增加的程度时，福利会不连续地上升。最后，联合福利在发送者与接收者之间的偏差上也是非单调的。我们的结果表明，验证技术的引入可能对社会福利产生非单调且不连续的影响，这取决于其成本以及双方之间的利益冲突。

title: DP775 Diffusion of Technical Change and the Decomposition of Output into Trend and Cycle
title_zh: 技术变革的扩散与产出分解为趋势和周期
title_primary: 技术变革的扩散与产出分解为趋势和周期
title_secondary: DP775 Diffusion of Technical Change and the Decomposition of Output into Trend and Cycle
authors: Marco Lippi, Lucrezia Reichlin, Alexander Bick, Adam Blandin, David Deming 等
official: 官方在线 1993-05-31 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: this paper we argue that modelling the trend component in real GNP as a random walk is inconsistent with its interpretation as productivity growth. As an alternative we specify the trend as an Auto Regressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA) process, whose impulse response function follows an S-shaped pattern reflecting the process of diffusion of technical change. Such an ARIMA process is employed to build and estimate an Unobserved Components ARIMA (UCARIMA) model using USA post-war quarterly data. We find that our model, although more parsimonious, fits the data as well as the standard random walk plus AR(2) cycle. Moreover, the cycle has a very low variance relative to the variance of the trend in our model.
abstract_zh: 本文认为，将实际GNP的趋势成分建模为随机游走，与其作为生产率增长的解释相矛盾。作为替代方案，我们将趋势设定为自回归积分滑动平均（ARIMA）过程，其脉冲响应函数遵循反映技术变革扩散过程的S型模式。我们利用美国战后季度数据，采用此类ARIMA过程构建并估计了不可观测成分ARIMA（UCARIMA）模型。研究发现，尽管我们的模型更为简约，但其拟合数据的效果与标准随机游走加AR(2)周期模型相当。此外，在我们的模型中，周期相对于趋势的方差具有极低的方差值。

title: A small volume reduction that melts down the market: Auctions with endogenous rationing
title_zh: 小规模减量引发市场崩盘：内生配给的拍卖
title_primary: 小规模减量引发市场崩盘：内生配给的拍卖
title_secondary: A small volume reduction that melts down the market: Auctions with endogenous rationing
authors: Karl‐Martin Ehrhart, Ann-Katrin Hanke, Marion Ott
official: 官方在线 2026-07-25 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Auctions with endogenous rationing have been introduced to stimulate competition. Such (procurement) auctions reduce the volume put out to tender when competition is low. This paper finds a strong negative effect of endogenous rationing on participation when bid-preparation is costly, counteracting the aim to stimulate competition. For multiple auctioneer's objectives mentioned in directives, we derive optimal mechanisms, which differ due to different evaluation of the tradeoff between participation and bid-preparation costs. Thus, the auctioneer needs to decide on an objective. However, reducing bid-preparation costs improves the optimal values of multiple objective functions.
abstract_zh: 内生配给拍卖被引入以刺激竞争。此类（采购）拍卖在竞争不足时会减少招标数量。本文发现，当投标准备成本较高时，内生配给对参与率产生显著的负向效应，这与刺激竞争的目标相悖。针对指令中提及的多种拍卖方目标，我们推导出最优机制，这些机制因对参与率与投标准备成本之间权衡的不同评估而存在差异。因此，拍卖方需要确定一个目标。然而，降低投标准备成本能够改善多个目标函数的最优值。

title: Knowledge Spillovers and the Growth of Local Industries
title_zh: 知识溢出与地方产业增长
title_primary: 知识溢出与地方产业增长
title_secondary: Knowledge Spillovers and the Growth of Local Industries
authors: Mario Forni, Sergio Paba
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2003-03-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In this paper we investigate the nature and directions of inter‐industry dynamic linkages across Italian manufacturing sectors. We perform a very disaggregated analysis in order to identify, for each 3‐digit industry, which composition of industrial activity is more conducive to growth. We find that diversity matters for growth, but each industry needs its own diversity. We provide some evidence of clustering of industries based on dynamic externalities. We find that many spillovers occur within input‐output relationships. They often originate in downstream sectors favouring the growth of upstream industries. Lastly, the importance of spillovers does not depend on the technological intensity of the industry.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了意大利制造业部门间产业动态关联的性质与方向。我们通过高度细化的分析，识别出每个三位数行业中，何种产业活动组合更有利于增长。研究发现，多样性对增长具有重要影响，但每个行业需要其特定的多样性结构。我们提供了基于动态外部性的产业集聚证据，并发现许多溢出效应发生在投入产出关系内部，这些效应通常源于下游部门，并促进上游产业的增长。最后，溢出效应的重要性并不取决于行业的技术密集程度。

title: Ambiguous Attribution: Theory and Evidence
title_zh: 模糊归因：理论与证据
title_primary: 模糊归因：理论与证据
title_secondary: Ambiguous Attribution: Theory and Evidence
authors: Ricardo Alonso, Monica Martinez-Bravo, Gerard Padro i Miquel, Carlos Sanz, Silvia Vannutelli
official: 官方在线 2026-07-21 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Clarity of responsibility is an essential element of political accountability. We develop a rational model of Bayesian updating in the presence of ambiguous attribution and we test its predictions using an original survey. We show that respondents' partisanship, assessment of public healthcare quality, and beliefs over which layer of government is responsible for healthcare are correlated as predicted: good-assessment voters attribute responsibility to the layer governed by their preferred party, while bad-assessment voters blame the layer governed by the party they dislike. These partisan patterns of credit and blame, often interpreted as evidence of motivated reasoning or partisan bias, can thus arise from rational Bayesian updating under attribution ambiguity. No such partisan patterns exist where the same party is in charge of regional and central government. A survey experiment in which we inform subjects of the official quality of healthcare has them update in the predicted, partisan, direction. Model and empirical results show that partisan priors are extremely hard to dislodge when attribution is ambiguous.
abstract_zh: 责任清晰性是政治问责的核心要素。我们构建了一个存在模糊归因情境下贝叶斯更新的理性模型，并通过原创性调查检验其预测。研究表明，受访者的党派倾向、对公共医疗质量的评估以及关于哪级政府负责医疗服务的信念之间存在预测性关联：评估良好的选民将责任归于其偏好政党执政的层级，而评估不佳的选民则将责任归咎于其厌恶政党执政的层级。这种党派性的褒贬模式常被解读为动机性推理或党派偏见的证据，但在归因模糊条件下，它实际上可能源于理性贝叶斯更新。当同一政党同时掌控地区与中央政府时，此类党派性模式便不复存在。在告知受访者官方医疗质量信息的调查实验中，其更新方向与预测的党派性方向一致。模型与实证结果表明，当归因模糊时，党派先验信念极难被撼动。

title: Understanding Latin America's Fertility Decline: Age, Education, and Cohort Dynamics
title_zh: 理解拉丁美洲生育率下降：年龄、教育与队列动态
title_primary: 理解拉丁美洲生育率下降：年龄、教育与队列动态
title_secondary: Understanding Latin America's Fertility Decline: Age, Education, and Cohort Dynamics
authors: InÃ©s, Berniell,, Raquel, FernÃ¡ndez,, Azul, MenduiÃ±a,, Onofri, Milagros
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper examines the sharp decline in fertility across Latin America using both period and cohort measures. Combining Vital Statistics, Census microdata, and UN population data, we decompose changes in fertility by age, education, and joint age-education groups. We show that the decline in period fertility between 2000 and 2022 is driven primarily by reductions in within-group birth rates rather than by changes in population composition, with the largest contributions coming from younger and less-educated women. Comparing the cohort born in the mid 1950s and the one born in the mid 1970s, we find that the decline in completed fertility reflects not only delayed childbearing but also substantial reductions in the average number of children per woman. This is driven primarily by lower fertility among mothers rather than by rising childlessness. Our findings provide new evidence on the nature of Latin America's transition to below-replacement fertility and highlight several open questions for future research.
abstract_zh: 本文利用时期与队列两种度量指标，考察了拉丁美洲生育率的急剧下降。通过整合生命统计数据、人口普查微观数据及联合国人口数据，我们按年龄、教育程度以及年龄-教育联合分组对生育率变化进行了分解。研究表明，2000年至2022年间时期生育率的下降主要源于组内生育率的降低，而非人口结构变化，其中年轻且受教育程度较低的女性贡献最大。对比20世纪50年代中期与70年代中期出生的队列，我们发现终身生育率的下降不仅反映了生育推迟，更体现了每位女性平均生育数量的显著减少。这一变化主要由已育女性生育率降低驱动，而非无子女比例上升所致。本研究为拉丁美洲向低于更替水平生育率转型的特征提供了新证据，并揭示了未来研究中若干待解的关键问题。

title: Partisan Entrepreneurship
title_zh: 党派创业
title_primary: 党派创业
title_secondary: Partisan Entrepreneurship
authors: JOSEPH ENGELBERG, JORGE GUZMAN, RUNJING LU, WILLIAM MULLINS
official: 官方在线 2026-07-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Republicans start more firms than Democrats. In a sample of 40 million party‐identified Americans between 2005 and 2017, we find that 5.5% of Republicans and 3.7% of Democrats become entrepreneurs. This partisan entrepreneurship gap is time‐varying—Republicans increase their relative entrepreneurship during Republican administrations and decrease it during Democratic administrations, amounting to a partisan reallocation of 170,000 new firms over our 13‐year sample. We find sharp changes in partisan entrepreneurship around the elections of President Obama and President Trump, with the strongest effects among the most politically active partisans: those that donate and vote.
abstract_zh: 共和党人比民主党人创办了更多企业。在2005年至2017年间4000万有党派归属的美国人的样本中，我们发现5.5%的共和党人和3.7%的民主党人成为企业家。这种党派创业差距具有时变性——共和党人在共和党执政期间相对创业率上升，在民主党执政期间下降，在我们的13年样本期内，这相当于17万家新企业的党派间重新配置。我们发现，在奥巴马总统和特朗普总统当选前后，党派创业行为发生了急剧变化，其中对政治参与度最高的党派成员（即捐款和投票者）影响最为显著。

title: The dynamics of costly norms
title_zh: 昂贵规范的形成机制
title_primary: 昂贵规范的形成机制
title_secondary: The dynamics of costly norms
authors: Sam Jindani, H Peyton Young
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Social norms that are costly for individuals are held in place because of social pressure to conform. Historical examples include duelling in Europe and footbinding in China; contemporary examples include female genital cutting and wasteful consumption. Such norms exhibit varied dynamics. Some collapse after staying unchanged for centuries, while others erode gradually. Still others escalate gradually before collapsing. This paper develops a theoretical framework that explains these patterns in terms of different forces of social influence and lends itself to empirical estimation. The analysis can guide the design of policies aimed at mitigating or eliminating costly norms, and shows that some interventions can be counterproductive.
abstract_zh: 摘要 对个体而言代价高昂的社会规范之所以得以维系，源于社会遵从压力。历史案例包括欧洲的决斗传统与中国缠足习俗；当代案例则涵盖女性割礼与炫耀性消费。此类规范呈现出多元演变特征：有的在延续数百年后骤然瓦解，有的逐步消解，还有的则在崩溃前经历渐进升级过程。本文构建的理论框架通过阐释社会影响力的不同作用机制来解释上述模式，并适用于实证估计。该分析可为旨在缓解或消除代价高昂规范的政策设计提供指导，同时揭示某些干预措施可能适得其反。

title: Monetary transmission and portfolio rebalancing: A cross-sectional approach
title_zh: 货币传导与投资组合再平衡：一种横截面方法
title_primary: 货币传导与投资组合再平衡：一种横截面方法
title_secondary: Monetary transmission and portfolio rebalancing: A cross-sectional approach
authors: Xu Lu, Lingxuan Wu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We show that institutional portfolio rebalancing across asset classes plays a key role in transmitting monetary shocks to the stock market. Around FOMC announcements, ceteris paribus, a stock with 10-percentage-point higher ownership by rebalancing institutions experiences an additional 3.7-basis-point loss following a 10-basis-point surprise rate hike. We corroborate our mechanism by exploiting within-firm variations for dual shares, showing stronger price reactions at quarter- and month-ends when rebalancing is more imminent, and presenting placebo tests contrasting rebalancing institutions with other institutions. A concluding calibration suggests rebalancing could contribute roughly one-third to two-thirds of the aggregate stock market excess return response to monetary shocks.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，机构投资者在资产类别间的组合再平衡在货币政策冲击向股市传导中扮演关键角色。在联邦公开市场委员会公告前后，在其他条件相同的情况下，若某只股票由进行再平衡的机构持有的比例高出10个百分点，则在利率意外上调10个基点时，该股票将额外损失3.7个基点。我们通过利用双重股份的公司内部差异来验证这一机制，显示在季度末和月末再平衡更为临近时，价格反应更为强烈，并通过对比再平衡机构与其他机构的安慰剂测试加以佐证。最终的校准分析表明，再平衡可能贡献了股票市场总体超额收益对货币政策冲击响应的约三分之一至三分之二。

title: The effects of immigration on agricultural development
title_zh: 移民对农业发展的影响
title_primary: 移民对农业发展的影响
title_secondary: The effects of immigration on agricultural development
authors: David Escamilla-Guerrero, Andrea Papadia, Ariell Zimran
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the effects of immigration during the Age of Mass Migration (1855–1920) on Brazil’s agricultural development in 1920. Instrumenting for a municipality’s immigrant share using the interaction of aggregate immigrant inflows and the expansion of Brazil’s railway network, we find that a greater share of European immigrants in a municipality led to an increase in farm values. The bulk of the effect was the product of more intense cultivation of land. We also find that it is unlikely that immigration slowed Brazil’s structural transformation. Our results imply that immigration into an emerging agricultural economy can contribute substantially to agricultural development.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了大规模移民时期（1855-1920年）移民对巴西1920年农业发展的影响。利用总移民流入与巴西铁路网络扩张的交互作用作为市政区移民比例的工具变量，我们发现，市政区中欧洲移民比例的增加导致了农场价值的提升。这一效应主要源于土地更密集的耕作。同时，我们也不认为移民减缓了巴西的结构转型。我们的研究结果表明，移民进入一个新兴农业经济体，能显著促进其农业发展。

title: Trade credit and relationships
title_zh: 贸易信贷与关系
title_primary: 贸易信贷与关系
title_secondary: Trade credit and relationships
authors: Felipe Benguria, Alvaro Garcia-Marin, Tim Schmidt-Eisenlohr
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Exploiting transaction-level international trade data, this paper documents that long-term firm-to-firm relationships facilitate the use of trade credit, with the strength of this effect varying with firm size, firms’ payment delays, and multinational affiliate status. Effects also depend on the strength of contract enforcement across countries and the complexity of products traded. Because trade credit can reduce the overall need to borrow from the financial sector, long-term relationships may reduce firms’ credit demand. The destruction of trade relationships, for example, through trade conflicts, may hence increase firms’ leverage.
abstract_zh: 利用交易层面的国际贸易数据，本文记录了长期企业间关系如何促进贸易信贷的使用，且这一效应的强度随企业规模、企业付款延迟及跨国子公司身份的不同而变化。该效应还受各国合同执行力度及交易产品复杂性的影响。由于贸易信贷能减少对金融部门整体借贷的需求，长期关系可能降低企业的信贷需求。因此，贸易关系的破坏，例如因贸易冲突所致，可能增加企业的杠杆率。

title: Chinese Trade Competition and Rural Mexican Migration
title_zh: 中国贸易竞争与墨西哥农村移民

title_secondary: Chinese Trade Competition and Rural Mexican Migration
authors: Zachariah Rutledge, Joaquin Mayorga
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: China's accession to the World Trade Organization in 2001 reshaped global trade, reducing U.S. demand for Mexican manufactured goods and weakening Mexico's manufacturing employment. This study estimates how this trade‐induced decline affected migration and employment decisions among rural Mexicans. Using individual‐level panel data from the Mexican National Rural Household Survey (ENHRUM) and a long‐difference framework, we instrument manufacturing employment with regional exposure to Chinese import competition. Results show that a 10‐percentage‐point decline in manufacturing employment increased the probability of U.S. migration by 24 percentage points and U.S. nonagricultural employment by 17 points, with no significant effects on agricultural employment.
abstract_zh: 2001年中国加入世界贸易组织重塑了全球贸易格局，导致美国对墨西哥制成品的需求下降，进而削弱了墨西哥制造业的就业水平。本研究旨在估算这一贸易冲击引发的制造业就业萎缩对墨西哥农村人口迁移及就业决策的影响。基于墨西哥国家农村家庭调查（ENHRUM）的个体层面面板数据，采用长期差分框架，以各地区对中国进口竞争的暴露度作为制造业就业的工具变量。结果表明：制造业就业率每下降10个百分点，农村人口迁移至美国的概率增加24个百分点，在美国从事非农就业的概率上升17个百分点，而对农业就业未产生显著影响。

title: Medicare Home Health Fraud: How Much, Where, and Who?
title_zh: 医疗保险家庭健康欺诈：规模、地域与主体
title_primary: 医疗保险家庭健康欺诈：规模、地域与主体
title_secondary: Medicare Home Health Fraud: How Much, Where, and Who?
authors: Liran Einav, Amy Finkelstein, Yunan Ji, Neale Mahoney, Gideon Moore
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: How much fraud is there in Medicare and who commits it? We provide an answer for Medicare home health, a setting widely considered especially rife with fraud. We define a home health agency (HHA) as fraudulent if it was prosecuted by a federal strike force. Combining Medicare claims data on all HHAs with hand-collected prosecution records from the nine federal judicial districts where strike forces operated between 2009 and 2013, we train a machine learning model to predict, out of sample, the probability that each HHA in the remaining 85 districts would have been prosecuted had a strike force been present. We estimate that in 2008, 3.4% of Medicare home health spending — about $520 million — was billed by fraudulent HHAs. The strike forces were well-targeted: their nine districts contained only 40% of home health spending but 65% of fraudulent spending. Fraudulent HHAs display intuitive characteristics: they are more likely to rely on extremely high-volume referring physicians, to exhibit unusually uniform patterns of care, and to serve healthier-than-average patients.
abstract_zh: 医疗保险欺诈的规模有多大？欺诈者是谁？我们以医疗保险家庭健康服务（普遍认为欺诈高发领域）为研究对象，将受到联邦特别行动组起诉的家庭健康机构定义为欺诈机构。通过整合全美所有家庭健康机构的医疗保险索赔数据，以及手工收集的2009-2013年间九个联邦司法辖区特别行动组的起诉记录，我们训练机器学习模型，预测其余85个司法辖区中每家家庭健康机构若存在特别行动组时被起诉的概率。研究估算显示，2008年医疗保险家庭健康支出中有3.4%（约5.2亿美元）由欺诈性家庭健康机构开具账单。特别行动组的靶向性显著：其覆盖的九个司法辖区虽仅占家庭健康总支出的40%，却集中了65%的欺诈性支出。欺诈性家庭健康机构呈现显著特征：更依赖超高转诊量的医师，护理模式异常统一，且服务对象健康水平高于平均水平。

title: Hand-to-mouth households in the eurosystem and the transmission of monetary policy
title_zh: 欧元体系中的手头拮据家庭与货币政策的传导
title_primary: 欧元体系中的手头拮据家庭与货币政策的传导
title_secondary: Hand-to-mouth households in the eurosystem and the transmission of monetary policy
authors: Okan Akarsu, Emrehan Aktuğ, Müşerref Küçükbayrak
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-15 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We revisit the question of the role of Hand-to-Mouth (HtM) households in monetary policy transmission across European countries, using the Household Finance and Consumption Survey (HFCS). Using European Central Bank (ECB) monetary shocks and panel local projections, we find that the aggregate output response of countries with higher HtM ratios is less pronounced following monetary policy shocks compared to those with lower HtM ratios. This aligns with the predictions of heterogeneous agent New Keynesian models with both wage and price rigidity. When wages are stickier than prices, real wages for HtM agents may decline despite interest rate cuts, which hinders the demand boost typically expected from the New Keynesian Cross. Consequently, monetary policy is less effective in stimulating aggregate demand in economies with a higher share of HtM households.
abstract_zh: 我们重新审视了手到口（HtM）家庭在欧洲各国货币政策传导中的作用，利用家庭金融与消费调查（HFCS）数据。借助欧洲中央银行（ECB）的货币冲击和面板局部投影方法，我们发现，在货币政策冲击后，HtM比率较高的国家，其总体产出反应相较于HtM比率较低的国家更为温和。这一发现与同时包含工资和价格粘性的异质性代理人新凯恩斯模型的预测相符。当工资比价格更具粘性时，尽管利率下调，HtM代理人的实际工资可能下降，这阻碍了新凯恩斯交叉通常预期的需求提振效应。因此，在HtM家庭占比更高的经济体中，货币政策在刺激总需求方面的效果较弱。

title: The impact of wildfire smoke on local avian biodiversity
title_zh: 野火烟雾对当地鸟类生物多样性的影响
title_primary: 野火烟雾对当地鸟类生物多样性的影响
title_secondary: The impact of wildfire smoke on local avian biodiversity
authors: Sarah Meier, Eric Strobl
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-13 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Land use alterations and climate change are shifting natural fire regimes, leading to prolonged and intensified fire seasons accompanied by widespread air pollution, with potentially important consequences for local wildlife. Combining data from the North American Breeding Bird Survey with high-resolution satellite imagery, we estimate the impact of wildfire-specific smoke pollution (PM2.5) on avian biodiversity in the contiguous United States (US) from 2008 to 2022. The panel fixed effects instrumental variable estimation results indicate a short-term adverse effect of PM2.5 on taxonomic and phylogenetic diversity metrics. More specifically, a standard deviation (sd) increase in wildfire-specific PM2.5 pollution reduces species richness, abundance, and phylogenetic diversity by about 0.1 sd. For the most polluted transects the effect is up to 2–3 standard deviations. The adverse impacts on biodiversity vary across ecosystems, with particularly pronounced effects in the North American Deserts and Eastern Temperate Forests. These findings underscore that fire management and conservation strategies should consider biodiversity impacts among the many factors guiding resource allocation, particularly as wildfire intensity and smoke exposure are projected to increase in many regions worldwide.
abstract_zh: 土地利用变化与气候变化正在改变自然火情格局，导致火灾季节延长且强度加剧，伴随大范围空气污染，对当地野生动物可能产生重要影响。结合北美繁殖鸟类调查数据与高分辨率卫星影像，我们估算了2008年至2022年间美国本土野火特定烟雾污染（PM2.5）对鸟类生物多样性的影响。面板固定效应工具变量估计结果表明，PM2.5对分类学及系统发育多样性指标存在短期不利影响。具体而言，野火特定PM2.5污染每增加一个标准差（sd），物种丰富度、丰度及系统发育多样性约降低0.1个标准差。对于污染最严重的样带，其影响可达2至3个标准差。生物多样性的不利影响因生态系统而异，在北美沙漠和东部温带森林中尤为显著。这些发现强调，火灾管理与保护策略在指导资源分配的众多因素中应考虑生物多样性影响，尤其是在全球许多地区野火强度及烟雾暴露预计将增加的背景下。

title: Measuring housing market slack
title_zh: 衡量住房市场疲软程度
title_primary: 衡量住房市场疲软程度
title_secondary: Measuring housing market slack
authors: N. Kundan Kishor
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper develops a framework to estimate U.S. housing market slack—the deviation of inventory from equilibrium levels needed for stability. We estimate a housing Phillips curve linking slack to house price growth, where slack is identified as the common cyclical component shared by existing and new home inventories. Results show a statistically significant inverse relationship between slack and price growth, with persistent negative slack since 2010 and extreme tightness during the pandemic. A shock to the estimated housing market slack generates substantial, lasting effects on house prices and rents, with rental impacts peaking 24 months after initial shocks.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个评估美国住房市场松弛度的框架，即库存偏离维持稳定所需均衡水平的程度。我们估计了一条住房菲利普斯曲线，将松弛度与房价增长联系起来，其中松弛度被识别为现有住房和新房库存共有的周期性成分。结果显示，松弛度与房价增长之间存在统计上显著的负相关关系，自2010年以来持续存在负松弛，并在疫情期间出现极度紧张状态。对估计的住房市场松弛度施加冲击，会对房价和租金产生显著且持久的影响，其中租金影响在初始冲击后24个月达到峰值。

title: Consumer Health Perceptions of Cows' Milk and Plant‐Based Milk Alternatives
title_zh: 消费者对牛奶与植物基奶替代品的健康认知
title_primary: 消费者对牛奶与植物基奶替代品的健康认知
title_secondary: Consumer Health Perceptions of Cows' Milk and Plant‐Based Milk Alternatives
authors: Danielle M. Kaminski, Wei Yang, Rodolfo M. Nayga Jr.
official: 官方在线 2026-06-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study used a best‐worst scale experiment to reveal consumers' beliefs about the healthiness of selected cows' milk and plant‐based milk products based on their nutrition panels. We find that while there is heterogeneity in health perceptions, consumers overwhelmingly select skim milk as the healthiest milk product. Additionally, the cows' milk nutrition panels are typically ranked healthier than the plant‐based milk products. Finally, we also conducted an additional intent‐to‐purchase experiment and find that there are significant differences in the preference shares of healthiness perceptions and intent to purchase, meaning that consumers consider more than just health in their purchase decisions.
abstract_zh: 本研究采用最优‐最差标度实验，基于营养标签揭示消费者对特定牛奶和植物基奶制品健康性的认知。我们发现，尽管健康认知存在异质性，但消费者绝大多数选择脱脂牛奶作为最健康的乳制品。此外，牛奶的营养标签通常被评定为比植物基奶制品更健康。最后，我们还进行了额外的购买意向实验，发现健康认知的偏好份额与购买意向之间存在显著差异，这意味着消费者在购买决策中考虑的不仅仅是健康因素。

title: Climate Change and Migration: The Case of Africa,
title_zh: 气候变化与移民：非洲案例研究
title_primary: 气候变化与移民：非洲案例研究
title_secondary: Climate Change and Migration: The Case of Africa,
authors: Bruno Conte
source: Journal of the European Economic Association
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: How will future climate change affect Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) in terms of migration and welfare? Can policymakers help SSA adapt to this process? I answer these questions with a quantitative framework that, coupled with rich spatial data and forecasts for the future climate, projects millions of climate migrants and unequal welfare losses across SSA. Investigating migration and trade liberalization as policy tools, I find persistent inequality in welfare losses if only migration barriers in SSA are reduced. Relaxing trade barriers addresses these distributional concerns, as do both policies combined. Yet, the policy mix is less effective in reducing aggregate losses due to inefficiencies arising from congestion externalities.
abstract_zh: 未来气候变化将如何影响撒哈拉以南非洲地区的移民与福利？政策制定者能否帮助该地区适应这一过程？本文通过构建一个量化分析框架，结合丰富的空间数据与未来气候预测，揭示了撒哈拉以南非洲地区将出现数百万气候移民及不均衡的福利损失。在将移民与贸易自由化作为政策工具进行研究时发现，若仅降低撒哈拉以南非洲地区的移民壁垒，福利损失的不平等现象将持续存在。放松贸易壁垒能够解决这些分配问题，而两项政策组合实施亦能达到同样效果。然而，由于拥挤外部性导致的效率损失，政策组合在减少总体损失方面的有效性有所降低。

title: Inflation, War Bonds, and Voter Backlash in the 1950s
title_zh: 20世纪50年代的通胀、战争债券与选民反弹
title_primary: 20世纪50年代的通胀、战争债券与选民反弹
title_secondary: Inflation, War Bonds, and Voter Backlash in the 1950s
authors: Gillian Brunet, Eric Hilt, Matthew Jaremski
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the role of war bonds and inflation in post-WWII federal elections. After WWII, major bouts of inflation in 1946-48 and 1950-51 depressed the real returns of the bonds sold to households during the war. In a difference-in-differences framework, we find that counties with higher war bond purchases shifted their votes towards the Republican Party in postwar elections. To address the endogeneity of war bond purchases, we use an instrumental variables design, and obtain similar results. Bond ownership raised the saliency of inflation, and the severe rise in prices after the war triggered a backlash against the incumbent Democrats.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了二战后的战争债券与通货膨胀在联邦选举中的作用。二战后，1946-48年和1950-51年的两次重大通胀压低了战争期间向家庭出售债券的实际回报。在双重差分框架下，我们发现战争债券购买量更高的县在战后选举中投票转向共和党。为解决战争债券购买的内生性问题，我们采用工具变量设计，并得到类似结果。债券持有提高了通胀的显著性，战后物价的急剧上涨引发了选民对在任民主党人的强烈反对。

title: Tax Salience: Experimental Evidence from Tanzania
title_zh: 税收显著性：来自坦桑尼亚的实验证据
title_primary: 税收显著性：来自坦桑尼亚的实验证据
title_secondary: Tax Salience: Experimental Evidence from Tanzania
authors: Odd-Helge Fjeldstad, Sunniva Nygård Ingholm, Lucas Katera, Emil Løstegård, Ingrid Hoem Sjursen 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In sub-Saharan Africa, the adoption of mobile money has grown substantially during the past decade, becoming an important driver of financial inclusion in the region. At the same time, many governments have introduced taxes on mobile money transfers, which may discourage use and encourage a return to cash-based transactions. In several countries, these taxes have been highly salient to taxpayers following public debate and subsequent rate reductions. This paper examines the effect of tax salience on the use of mobile money. Drawing on a lab experiment with small business owners in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania, we randomly vary whether participants are reminded of an existing mobile money tax when making incentivized choices between receiving payments in cash or via mobile money. We find that increasing the salience of the tax significantly reduces the share of participants choosing mobile money. Evidence from a post-experiment questionnaire indicates that participants were well informed about the tax, suggesting that the effect does not operate through lack of knowledge.
abstract_zh: 在撒哈拉以南非洲地区，过去十年间移动货币的采用率显著增长，成为该地区金融包容性的重要推动力。与此同时，多国政府引入了针对移动货币转账的税收，这可能抑制其使用并促使人们回归现金交易。在若干国家，经过公众辩论及随后的税率下调，这些税收对纳税人而言高度显著。本文探讨了税收显著性对移动货币使用的影响。基于在坦桑尼亚达累斯萨拉姆与小微企业主进行的实验室实验，我们在参与者于现金与移动货币收款方式之间做出激励性选择时，随机改变是否提醒他们现有移动货币税收的存在。研究发现，提高税收显著性显著降低了参与者选择移动货币的比例。实验后问卷的证据表明，参与者对税收了解充分，暗示该效应并非通过信息缺乏发挥作用。

title: Optimal Selling Mechanisms With Endogenous Seller Outside Offers
title_zh: 内生卖方外部报价下的最优销售机制
title_primary: 内生卖方外部报价下的最优销售机制
title_secondary: Optimal Selling Mechanisms With Endogenous Seller Outside Offers
authors: Xiaogang Che, Tong Li, Jingfeng Lu, Xiaoyong Zheng
official: 官方在线 2026-01-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We examine a two-stage selling mechanism design problem, where the buyer makes her report and the seller endogenously decides his effort (hidden investment) to generate a possibly better outside offer. The optimal mechanism shows that the seller's effort depends on the reported value of the buyer; a higher value lowers the seller's incentive to invest in the outside offer. After the price of the outside offer is realized, if the buyer's virtual value is less than the price, the seller takes the outside offer, and a termination fee equal to the virtual value is paid to the buyer.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个两阶段销售机制设计问题，其中买方进行报告，卖方内生地决定其努力（隐性投资）以可能产生更优的外部报价。最优机制表明，卖方的努力取决于买方报告的价值；较高的价值会降低卖方投资于外部报价的激励。当外部报价的价格实现后，如果买方的虚拟价值低于该价格，卖方将接受外部报价，并向买方支付相当于虚拟价值的终止费用。

title: Three reasons to price carbon under uncertainty: Accuracy of simple rules
title_zh: 不确定性下碳定价的三个理由：简单规则的准确性
title_primary: 不确定性下碳定价的三个理由：简单规则的准确性
title_secondary: Three reasons to price carbon under uncertainty: Accuracy of simple rules
authors: Ton Bremer, Christoph Hambel, Frederick Ploeg
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-01-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: An easy‐to‐interpret rule for the optimal risk‐adjusted social cost of carbon is derived using perturbation analysis. This rule internalizes the adverse effects of global warming on the risk of recurring climate‐related disasters, the risk of irreversible cascading climate tipping points, and the usual effect on total factor productivity. It and its three components approximate the true numerical optimum well, especially if the small parameters (i.e., the share of damages in GDP, the sensitivity of the risk of disasters to temperature and the risk of climate tipping) are small enough and the discount rate is not too small. The rule is also accurate if applied to AK models with a different supply side, for example, with ongoing technical progress in fossil‐fuel production or multiple economic sectors. With a growth‐adjusted discount rate of 2%/year, the SCC is $172/tCO 2 , 70% of which is due to recurring climate disasters and 9% to climate tipping risk.
abstract_zh: 通过扰动分析，推导出一个易于解释的最优风险调整社会碳成本规则。该规则内化了全球变暖对以下方面的不利影响：气候相关灾害反复发生的风险、不可逆级联气候临界点风险，以及对全要素生产率的常规影响。该规则及其三个组成部分能够较好地近似真实数值最优解，尤其是当小参数（即GDP中损害份额、灾害风险对温度的敏感性以及气候临界点风险）足够小且贴现率不太低时。若将该规则应用于具有不同供给侧结构的AK模型（例如化石燃料生产持续技术进步或多经济部门模型），其准确性依然成立。在增长调整贴现率为每年2%的情况下，社会碳成本为172美元/吨二氧化碳，其中70%源于反复发生的气候灾害，9%源于气候临界点风险。

title: Understanding Improvements in Reading Performance in Liberia: Investigating the Centrality of Text
title_zh: 利比里亚阅读表现提升的理解：探究文本的核心作用
title_primary: 利比里亚阅读表现提升的理解：探究文本的核心作用
title_secondary: Understanding Improvements in Reading Performance in Liberia: Investigating the Centrality of Text
authors: Alicia Menendez, Ursula Hoadley, Anna Solovyeva
official: 官方在线 2025-09-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study evaluates the effect of the Read Liberia intervention that provided teacher training, coaching, and teaching and learning materials, reaching 57,600 grades 1 and 2 students across 640 schools. Exploiting the randomized assignment of schools to the program, we find that Read Liberia improved students’ ability to read a paragraph, doubling oral reading fluency in intervention schools relative to control schools (an effect size of 0.60 standard deviations), and increased their ability to comprehend that paragraph (oral reading comprehension) by 12–13 percentage points, corresponding to an effect size of 0.47 standard deviations. On the basis of the analysis of the program implementation data, teachers’ and students’ surveys, and in-depth classroom observations, we argue that the improvements in reading performance are driven by the availability and utilization of Read Liberia reading materials and not by improved teaching practices in schools. Good-quality reading materials combined with improved instructional practices have the potential to generate even higher effects.
abstract_zh: 本研究评估了“利比里亚阅读”干预项目的效果，该项目提供教师培训、辅导及教学与学习材料，覆盖640所学校的57,600名一、二年级学生。利用学校随机分配至项目的机制，我们发现“利比里亚阅读”项目提升了学生朗读段落的能力，使干预学校的口语阅读流利度相对于对照学校翻倍（效应量为0.60个标准差），并提高了他们理解该段落的能力（口语阅读理解），增幅为12至13个百分点，对应效应量为0.47个标准差。基于对项目实施数据的分析、教师与学生调查以及深入的课堂观察，我们认为阅读表现的提升是由“利比里亚阅读”阅读材料的可用性和使用所驱动，而非学校教学实践的改进。高质量的阅读材料结合改进的教学实践，有可能产生更高的效果。

title: The TFP transmission effects of digital economy: evidence from China
title_zh: 数字经济对全要素生产率的传导效应：来自中国的证据
title_primary: 数字经济对全要素生产率的传导效应：来自中国的证据
title_secondary: The TFP transmission effects of digital economy: evidence from China
authors: Xue Ren Meiwei Tang Xiaoyue Yan Hui Peng a School of Mathematics and Statistics, Chongqing Key Laboratory of Statistical Intelligent Computing and Monitoring, Chongqing Technology and Business University, Chongqing, Chinab School of Economics, Nanjing University of Finance and Economics, Nanjing 等
official: 官方在线 2025-08-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Digital technology is wider penetration, as reflected in its ability to directly or indirectly embed the improvement of productivity efficiency into other industries. Utilizing the China’s Industrial Productivity (CIP) database and industry classification, we employ the growth accounting method to measure Total Factor Productivity (TFP) for various industries and the digital economy. And we further construct the TFP input-output model, dismantling the factor input and final demand, to explore China ‘s production efficiency linkage and transmission path across digital economy and various industries. Our empirical results show that TFP input and final demand have increased after multiple transmitting by digital economy, but these TFP transmission effect is mainly within the digital economy itself, its pervasiveness effect to other industries is still weak. Moreover, from industrial perspective, high-tech-dependent industries show higher sensitivity and influence than non-technology-dependent industries when considering TFP input, and the feed-back effect to digital economy of TFP technology spillover from producer services is higher than that of advanced manufacture. This study provides new perspectives and critical empirical evidence on how TFP can penetrate and transmit to other industries through digital economy, offering significant policy implications for enhancing the spillover effects of the digital economy and optimizing industrial policy.
abstract_zh: 数字技术的渗透性日益增强，体现在其能够直接或间接地将生产效率的提升嵌入其他产业之中。借助中国工业生产率（CIP）数据库及行业分类，我们采用增长核算方法测算了各行业及数字经济的全要素生产率（TFP）。进一步地，我们构建了TFP投入产出模型，分解要素投入与最终需求，以探究中国数字经济与各行业间的生产效率联动及其传导路径。实证结果显示，经过数字经济的多次传导，TFP投入与最终需求均有所增长，但这些TFP传导效应主要局限于数字经济内部，其对其他行业的渗透效应仍显薄弱。此外，从产业视角看，高技术依赖行业在TFP投入方面展现出比非技术依赖行业更高的敏感性与影响力，而生产者服务业对数字经济的TFP技术溢出反馈效应高于先进制造业。本研究为理解TFP如何通过数字经济渗透并传导至其他行业提供了新视角与关键实证依据，对增强数字经济溢出效应及优化产业政策具有重要政策启示。
